We got a list of templates (4 entries). Need to return the mapped_rxn associated with the template that, when applied to the molecule, reproduces the reaction: TMSOTf protecting alcohols. The forward reaction is protection (alcohol + TMSOTf -> TMS ether). Retrosynthetic step is deprotection: TMS ether -> alcohol. So we need a template that when applied to the protected molecule (given) yields the alcohol precursor. The search returned templates; we need to identify which one matches our molecule.

We have the target molecule SMILES: "C/C(=C/[C@H]1O[C@@H](CC=O)C[C@H](O[Si](C)(C)C(C)(C)C)[C@H]1C)CO". That's a TMS ether (O[Si](C)(C)C(C)(C)C). The template should have O-Si bond broken to give O-H.

Look at each template's mapped_rxn:

1st entry (reaction_id 149040) mapped_rxn: 'O=S(=O)(O[Si:11]([CH3:12])([CH3:13])[C:14]([CH3:15])([CH3:16])[CH3:17])C(F)(F)F.[CH3:1][CH2:2][O:3][C:4](=[O:5])[CH2:6][C@H:7]1[CH2:8][C@H:9]([OH:10])[C@@H:18]([CH3:19])[C@@H:20](/[CH:21]=[C:22](/[CH3:23])[C:24](=[O:25])[O:26][CH3:27])[O:28]1>>[CH3:1][CH2:2][O:3][C:4](=[O:5])[CH2:6][C@H:7]1[CH2:8][C@H:9]([O:10][Si:11]([CH3:12])([CH3:13])[C:14]([CH3:15])([CH3:16])[CH3:17])[C@@H:18]([CH3:19])[C@@H:20](/[CH:21]=[C:22](/[CH3:23])[C:24](=[O:25])[O:26][CH3:27])[O:28]1'

This includes a sulfonyl fluoride reagent O=S(=O)(O[Si]...). That's not our reaction (TMSOTf). So not correct.

2nd entry (reaction_id 251782) mapped_rxn: '[CH3:1][C@H:2]([CH2:3][OH:5])[C@H:6]1[CH2:7][CH2:8][C@H:9]2[C@@H:10]([O:11][Si:12]([CH3:13])([CH3:14])[C:15]([CH3:16])([CH3:17])[CH3:18])[CH2:19][CH2:20][CH2:21][C@:22]12[CH3:23].CC1=CC=[C:4](S(=O)(=O)Cl)C=C1.CC1=C(C)C(N)=NC=C1.[C-]#N.[Na+].ClCCl.O>>[CH3:1][C@H:2]([CH2:3][CH:4]=[O:5])[C@H:6]1[CH2:7][CH2:8][C@H:9]2[C@@H:10]([O:11][Si:12]([CH3:13])([CH3:14])[C:15]([CH3:16])([CH3:17])[CH3:18])[CH2:19][CH2:20][CH2:21][C@:22]12[CH3:23]'

This seems to be a deprotection of a TMS ether (O[Si]...). The reactant side (right side) is the protected molecule (with O[Si]) and product side (left side) is the alcohol (CH2OH). The template appears to be a deprotection using some reagents (maybe TBAF). But the forward reaction (protect) would be alcohol + TMSOTf -> TMS ether + TfOH. This template is for deprotection, but the forward direction is protection? Actually the mapped_rxn shows reactants (left) include alcohol and some reagents, product (right) is protected molecule. Wait mapping: In mapped_rxn, left side is reactants, right side is products. The string: '[CH3:1][C@H:2]([CH2:3][OH:5])... . CC1=... . ... O>>[CH3:1][C@H:2]([CH2:3][CH:4]=[O:5])... [O:11][Si:12]...' So left side includes alcohol and other reagents, right side includes protected molecule. So forward reaction is protection. Good. So this template matches our forward reaction (alcohol + TMSOTf?). However reagents are not TMSOTf but some other reagents (maybe TMSCl?). But still O-Si bond formed. So this template likely appropriate.

Third entry (reaction_id 37276) mapped_rxn: includes O[Si] on product side? Let's see: product side (right) is ...[O:27]1 (no Si). Reactant side includes O[Si] (protected). So forward direction is deprotection? Actually left side includes O[Si] (protected) and other reagents, right side includes OH groups. So forward is deprotection. Not our forward.

Fourth entry (reaction_id 25652) similar: left side includes O[Si] (protected) and right side includes OH. So forward is deprotection.

Thus the template we need is the one where forward is protection (alcohol + TMSOTf -> TMS ether). That's entry 2 (reaction_id 251782). The template_id we need to return is the integer used to search the database, not the hash. The search result includes 'template_hash' and other fields but not explicit template_id. The 'reaction_id' is maybe not the template_id. The tool likely returns entries with fields: reaction_id, template_hash, retro_smarts_template, canonical_smarts_template, mapped_rxn, product_smiles, reactant_smiles, dataset, source_row_id, derive_version, similarity. The template_id likely corresponds to reaction_id? Or there is separate template ID. In earlier tasks, they used 'template_id' as integer referencing the template. Probably reaction_id is the template ID. We'll assume template_id = 251782.

We need to return dict with mapped_rxn string and template_id integer.
